PDF Feature-Preserving Volume Data Reduction and Focus+Context Visualization
Abstract- The growing sizes of volumetric data sets pose a great challenge for interactive visualization. In this paper, we present a feature-preserving data reduction and focus+context visualization method based on transfer function driven, continuous voxel repositioning and resampling techniques.
